title: Handoff
description: Typed handoff envelope dispatch-review.sh and spawn-worker.sh validate before spawning. Makes the file + event-log substrate a typed handoff bus with zero new infra. The payload_ref field is inline for payloads ≤ 4KB and a file-path string for payloads above that threshold — EVOLUTION.md documents the threshold rationale. New in host-agnostic v1 (pass-2).

task_id.description: Task ID associated with this handoff. Null only for pre-task bootstrap handoffs (e.g. chanakya→chanakya session seed).

reason.description: Short, human-readable why. ≤ 200 chars. Drives routing visibility in dashboards.

idempotency_key.description: Per contracts/idempotency.md: `<agent>:<mode>:<stable-subject>:<content-hash>`. Retries on the same inputs produce the same key and are deduped on the receiver side.

allOf.description: Worker→worker handoffs forbidden per REVIEW.md (pass-2). Argus never handoffs to achilles directly — verdict returns to chanakya. Achilles never handoffs to argus directly — chanakya routes via dispatch-review.sh.

agentName.description: Known agent roster. luban and chiron don't exist yet but are reserved to prevent future enum churn.

payloadRef.description: Inline object when payload serializes to ≤ 4KB. File path (relative to project root) otherwise. The 4KB threshold matches the PIPE_BUF atomicity limit on events.md and keeps small handoffs fully self-describing on the wire.

oneOf.description: Inline payload. Serializer must verify ≤ 4KB before emitting.
File path (relative or absolute) to a payload file. The receiver reads and validates.
